fusions.name: Staked and Butted
fusions.desc: Hooks the target on a mesh line staked at your feet and butts it, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a weighted mesh along the ground in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: You anchor yourself with your mesh and refuse to move: you take 20% less damage for 10 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn to attack you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Knots Pulled Tight
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, your mesh pulls a knot tighter around you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once into a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per knot (56% at full). Unfed, a knot loosens every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
